title: GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.19821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compiler pass selection is usually governed by fixed pipelines (-O2, -O3) or hand-written heuristics. We study whether a graph neural network (GNN) over a program's control-flow graph (CFG) can select among a fixed menu of five pass sequences in a single forward pass. GraphPass encodes each CFG with a graph attention (GAT) or graph convolutional (GCN) encoder and classifies it into one of the five sequences. On a synthetic benchmark of 5,000 generated CFGs in five program families, both encoders agree with the benchmark's reference label on about 92% of held-out programs, versus 68.4% for a hand-written rule-based heuristic and 85% for a flat MLP. An edge ablation indicates that this gain comes from per-block processing rather than from CFG edges: a GCN given the same basic-block features with all edges removed scores 95.0%, versus 92.2% with the true CFG. translated_title: GraphPass：图神经网络用于编译器优化遍选择的研究
translated_abstract: 编译器优化遍的选择通常由固定流水线（-O2、-O3）或手工编写的启发式规则决定。我们研究基于程序控制流图（CFG）的图神经网络（GNN）能否在单次前向传播中从固定的五个优化遍序列菜单中进行选择。GraphPass 使用图注意力（GAT）或图卷积（GCN）编码器对每个 CFG 进行编码，并将其分类为五个序列之一。在一个由五个程序族的 5,000 个生成 CFG 构成的合成基准上，两种编码器在约 92% 的保留测试程序上与基准的参考标签一致，而手工编写的基于规则的启发式方法仅为 68.4%，扁平的多层感知机（MLP）为 85%。一项关于边的消融实验表明，这一增益来自逐基本块的处理而非 CFG 边本身：使用相同基本块特征但移除所有边的 GCN 达到 95.0% 的准确率，而使用真实 CFG 时为 92.2%。在该基准中，标签由程序族决定，因此该任务的实……
tldr: GraphPass 利用图神经网络（GAT/GCN）对程序控制流图进行编码，在单次前向传播中从五个固定编译器优化遍序列中做出选择，准确率约达 92%，显著优于手工启发式规则和 MLP，且消融实验显示性能提升主要来自逐基本块特征处理而非 CFG 边信息。
en_tdlr: GraphPass employs graph neural networks (GAT/GCN) to encode program control-flow graphs and select among five fixed compiler pass sequences in a single forward pass, achieving about 92% accuracy that substantially outperforms hand-written heuristics and an MLP, with ablations showing the gains stem mainly from per-block feature processing rather than CFG edges.
